name: What is the process for ordering custom interior doors?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for ordering custom interior doors?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process typically begins with a consultation to discuss your vision, requirements, and budget. Our team will take precise measurements of your door openings and help you select materials, styles, and finishes. After design approval, the doors are custom manufactured, and then scheduled for professional installation. To prepare, measure your current door openings and gather any inspiration images you have, such as photos of door styles or specific materials you like, to help expedite the design phase.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves consultation, precise measurements, material and design selection, manufacturing, and professional installation. Prepare measurements and inspiration photos.
